## Key Facts

- Package: @rnforge/react-native-in-app-updates
- 6 main functions: getUpdateStatus, startImmediateUpdate, startFlexibleUpdate, completeFlexibleUpdate, addInstallStateListener, openStorePage
- 6 helper predicates: isUpdateAvailable, canStartImmediateUpdate, canStartFlexibleUpdate, canCompleteFlexibleUpdate, canOpenStorePage, supportsInstallStateListener
- Android: Play Core immediate + flexible update flows
- iOS: Store page helpers, Play-style flows reported as unsupported
- Built with Nitro for type-safe native bridging
